meaning: 致所有顾客，面向全体客户
usageNote: 公告开头常见套话！超正式场合用，就像店家广播喊话，语气礼貌又官方～

examples.en: This message is addressed to all customers who purchased the product last month.
examples.zh: 此消息发送给上个月购买该产品的所有顾客。

examples.en: To all customers: our store will be closed on Sunday for maintenance.
examples.zh: 致所有顾客：本店周日因维护暂停营业。
